# Vendored stable skills

This directory contains the stable skill corpus pinned from `mattpocock/skills` at revision `9c9f36ccd3995266cd675468af71639c8dde1ec5`.

`prolog-rlm` uses the upstream `SKILL.md` frontmatter as discovery metadata but replaces model-side invocation with Prolog-owned automatic activation. See `../../UPSTREAM.md` and `../../../docs/skills.md`.
